metric_policy.image_labels: label_rgbt over good and RGB-or-IR-visible anomalies
metric_policy.image_score: released industrial rule: normalize a component only if outside [0,1], then 0.5 detection + 0.5 max RGB patch map
metric_policy.pixel_labels: RGB masks for good and RGB-visible anomalies only; IR-only anomalies excluded
metric_policy.selection: mean of macro image-combined AUROC and macro RGB-pixel AUROC
metric_policy.diagnostics: detection-only AUROC/AP and modality-subgroup score distributions are diagnostic only and never affect checkpoint selection
